ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a two-port resistor network. At the bottom is a common node/common wire, serving as the reference node of the two ports. The upper end of the left port is the port 1 node, marked with voltage E1 and current I1 entering the network, and this node is connected to the bottom common node through a 5 Ω resistor. The upper end of the right port is the port 2 node, marked with voltage E2 and current I2 entering the network, and this node is connected to the bottom common node through a 10 Ω resistor. A 20 Ω resistor is directly connected between the upper-end nodes of the two ports. Reasoning: In the Y parameters, I1 = Y11 E1 + Y12 E2. Write the node current equation for the upper-end node of port 1; the current in the 20 Ω resistor flowing from the port 1 node to the port 2 node is (E1 - E2)/20. Therefore, the coefficient contributed by E2 in I1 is -1/20 S. The 5 Ω branch only affects Y11 and does not affect the direct coupling coefficient of E2 to I1. So Y12 = -1/20 = -0.05 mho.

method.method_draft: First describe the image topology: identify the common bottom node, the port-1 top node with a 5 Ω shunt, the port-2 top node with a 10 Ω shunt, and the 20 Ω resistor between the two top nodes. Since the question asks for admittance parameter Y12 in I1 = Y11 E1 + Y12 E2, take the off-diagonal nodal admittance between the two port nodes. The only element directly coupling E2 into I1 is the 20 Ω resistor, so Y12 = -1/20 S = -0.05 mho.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个二端口电阻网络，底部是一条公共节点/公共导线，作为两个端口的参考节点。左侧端口上端为端口1节点，标有电压 E1 和进入网络的电流 I1，该节点通过一个 5 Ω 电阻接到底部公共节点。右侧端口上端为端口2节点，标有电压 E2 和进入网络的电流 I2，该节点通过一个 10 Ω 电阻接到底部公共节点。两个端口的上端节点之间直接连接一个 20 Ω 电阻。推理：Y 参数中 I1 = Y11 E1 + Y12 E2。对端口1上端节点写节点电流，20 Ω 电阻中由端口1节点流向端口2节点的电流为 (E1 - E2)/20。因此 I1 中由 E2 贡献的系数是 -1/20 S。5 Ω 支路只影响 Y11，不影响 E2 对 I1 的直接耦合系数。所以 Y12 = -1/20 = -0.05 mho。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct nodal-admittance extraction from the circuit topology; it uses the off-diagonal entry of the node admittance matrix rather than solving a larger set of equations.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the figure as a two-port with a common bottom reference conductor, a 5 Ω shunt from port-1 top node to reference, a 10 Ω shunt from port-2 top node to reference, and a 20 Ω resistor connecting the two top port nodes. Note currents enter the ports and voltages E1, E2 are measured top node relative to the common bottom line.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text to identify that the requested quantity is the admittance parameter Y12 of the shown 2-port network, not an impedance or transmission parameter.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: For a resistor connecting two port nodes, the nodal admittance matrix has off-diagonal terms equal to the negative branch admittance: Y12 = -1/R_between. Shunt resistors only affect diagonal admittance terms.
